programme.desc: Commando Vijay arrests a terrorist, Master DD. However, he realises that Master DD is just a pawn and tries to find the real culprit.

programme.title: 100 Days of Love

programme.title: Prithipal Singh...A Story
programme.desc: Disappointed with his Olympic bronze medal, Prithipal Singh quits hockey and joins a university. However, things get worse for him when he is accused of murdering a student.

programme.title: Karishma Kudrat Ka
programme.desc: Widower Vijay lives in a village with his family. He unwittingly makes an enemy in Lala and a bandit, Bhagad, who conspire and throw him out of the village. But Vijay soon returns as a changed man.

programme.title: Avinash
programme.desc: Avinash, a singer and a dealer of stolen goods, finds his life turned upside down when some goons break into his house and assault his fiancee.

programme.title: Alag
programme.desc: Tejas, an odd boy who grew up in a basement, is moved to a rehabilitation centre after his father's death. When he starts displaying psychic powers, a scientist abducts him for experimentation.

programme.title: Jungle
programme.desc: Anu and Siddhu are in love and Siddhu turns up when Anu's family camps in a tiger sanctuary for a holiday. Unexpectedly, a sandalwood smuggler takes several members as hostages.

programme.title: Yes Boss
programme.desc: Rahul's boss Siddharth is a womaniser who blackmails Rahul into helping him win over Seema. But Rahul ends up falling in love with Seema and is torn between his career aspirations and his sweetheart.

programme.title: Payback
programme.desc: The lives of an architect and his wife are turned upside down when a stranger kidnaps their daughter and blackmails them to do some crimes for him.

programme.title: Powerfull Yoddha

programme.title: Dhongee

programme.title: Aaj Ka Mahaatma
programme.desc: Randhir, a straightforward and hardworking man, sets out to avenge the death of his twin brother Ranvir, a criminal, who was murdered by a prison inmate.

programme.title: Falak
programme.desc: Ramnath, a watchman, is killed while stopping his corrupt bosses from committing a crime. Years later, his sons decide to exact revenge against his murderers.

programme.title: Farz
programme.desc: Gopal, a secret agent, investigates the death of his colleague who possessed evidence against a known terrorist. Gopal and Kamla embark on a journey to find the traitor.

programme.title: Shehzaade
programme.desc: Suraj, a justice-loving man, must face a series of obstacles when he discovers his widowed mother's affair with a former prisoner.

programme.title: 15th August
programme.desc: Nagpal kills Chaudhry and his son, Ram, a military officer. Chaudhry's second son, Vikram, vows to destroy Nagpal who is all set to become the Chief Minister on the upcoming Indian Independence Day.

programme.title: Monster Snakes

programme.title: Alaska's Grizzly Gauntlet

programme.title: Snakes In The City
programme.desc: Ten Foot Mamba: Simon takes on a big green mamba, Sioux meets an angry monitor lizard and their apprentice gets a fright when a black mamba turns on her. 7+ (S8, ep 2)

programme.title: Yukon Vet
programme.desc: Dirty Rotten Chompers: Dr Oakley scrambles to save a dog after it ingests human supplements, operates on a deer's suspicious lump and removes the eye of an alpaca. (S11, ep 2)

programme.desc: Captain & Striker: Tig's moose hunt is thwarted by a pack of wolves, Marvin races to repair his home, Jody endures heavy snow and John makes the most of a typhoon. U. (S2, ep 5)

programme.title: Snakes In The City

programme.title: Animals Gone Wild

programme.title: Shark Men

programme.title: Mediterranean From Above

programme.title: Peppa Pig

programme.title: Peppa Pig

programme.title: Peppa Pig

programme.title: Peppa Pig

programme.title: Peppa Pig

programme.title: Peppa Pig

programme.title: Peppa Pig

programme.title: Peppa Pig

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Grandpa Pig's Computer: Mummy Pig gives her old computer to Granny and Grandpa Pig. They use it for lots of important work - as well as Happy Mrs Chicken. But who will fix it when it breaks?

programme.title: Peppa Pig

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: The campers meet two backwoods narwhals in 'Sugar Squeeze', then in 'Tag, You're It', On a rainy day, SpongeBob and his friends entertain themselves indoors with a turbulent game of tag. (S1, ep 2)

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: Krabs reignites his passion for clowning in 'Krabsy the Klown', then in 'Lords of the LARP', Mo learns a new kind of fun and camaraderie. (S2, ep 8)

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: Plankton recruits Sandy to help in his lab in 'Mad Science Squirrel', then in 'To Pop a Bubble', SpongeBob's new friend proves unpopular at camp. (S2, ep 1)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob befriends a talking Krabby Patty whose only wish is to be eaten in 'My Friend Patty', then in 'Fun-Believable', Rube explores little known oddities and attractions around Bikini Bottom.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Patrick and GrandPat try to pass each other on the stairs in 'Stair Wars', then in 'Enemies a la Mode', the members of the Star family each confront their own absurd rivalries. (S1, ep 2)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: The Star family gets trapped in the bathroom in 'The Commode Episode', then in 'Tying the Klop-Knot', Bunny and Cecil need to have another Klopnodian wedding. (S2, ep 6)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: In 'Bubblestand' SpongeBob introduces his friends to the art of bubble blowing, and in 'Ripped Pants' SpongeBob tries to impress Sandy at Mussel Beach. (S1, ep 2)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Patrick and SpongeBob time-travel back to Viking times in 'Visiting Vikings', then in 'It's Too Late... With Plankton' Squidina hires Plankton to entertain the Lawnies. (S4, ep 12)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Bunny's mother visits from the old country in 'Which Witch is Which?', and then in 'Get Off My Lawnie', Granny Tentacles gets her own spin-off show. (S1, ep 25)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob shrinks the whole of Bikini Bottom in 'Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy IV', and then in 'Doing Time', Mrs. Puff is sent to prison when SpongeBob crashes his boat.

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: Camp Master Krabs hires the Flying Dutchman to run the camp store in 'Boo Light Special', then in 'Lake Crashers', The campers have a demolition derby under Lake Yuckymuck. (S1, ep 18)

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: An unsatisfied anchovy strays from his brothers in 'What About Meep?', then in 'Hard Time Out', SpongeBob is sent to time out on behalf of his buddy, so Patrick does what he can to help. (S1, ep 7)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob's favourite jellyfishing net goes missing in 'The Pink Purloiner', and then in 'Squid Wood', SpongeBob decides that if he can't hang around with the real Squidward, he'll make his own.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Mr Krabs is messing up Pearl's preparations in 'The Slumber Party', and then in 'Grooming Gary', SpongeBob gives Gary a makeover, so that he can enter him in a pet show. But Gary's not so keen.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: The show finds an adorable new star in 'Patty-Poo', then in 'Swaptoberfest', the Star family swap identities. (S3, ep 7)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Patrick ventures inside Cecil to learn how the body works in 'To Dad and Back', then in 'Survivoring', Cecil takes his kids camping, but Squidina wants the drama of reality TV. (S1, ep 9)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: The Great Patty Caper: SpongeBob, Patrick and Plankton solve a mystery on a runaway train.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Plankton teams up with Man Ray to take over the Krusty Krab and the world in 'Super Evil Aquatic Villain Team Up Is Go!', and in 'Chum Fricassee', Squidward quits the Krusty Krab to work for Plankton!

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: It's Kamp Koral's first ever Wild West Day in 'A Finful of Sand Dollars', then in 'Cretins of the Night', SpongeBob and Patrick become vampires for a night. (S2, ep 11)

programme.title: Beneath the Bun: Krabby Patty ...

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Patrick hosts a time-travelling food show in 'Time to Eat', then in 'Cleaning House', while Bunny's in Klopnod, the Star home becomes a mess. (S2, ep 13)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: The Stars' neighbour Gladys is a local vigilante in 'Neighborhood Wash', then in 'A Fridge Too Far', Patrick, GrandPat, and Cecil want Bunny to honor their accomplishments on the fridge. (S5, ep 5)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob tries to catch a Moon Jelly in 'Mooned!', then in 'Hysterical History', Sandy learns some Bikini Bottom history. (S14, ep 8)
